meta.title: Pricing | InkyBay
meta.description: InkyBay plans from $19.99 a month, each with a 21-day free trial. Billed through Shopify in USD; save 20% with yearly billing.

source: Plans, prices and features from the Shopify App Store listing (apps.shopify.com/productsdesigner), October 2026

title: Simple pricing
that grows with your store.
hero.lead: Every plan starts with a 21-day free trial. Billing runs through Shopify in USD, and you can change plans or uninstall at any time.

items.title: Billing through Shopify
items.text: Charges appear on your Shopify invoice, every 30 days.

faqs.a: InkyBay is billed through Shopify in USD. Recurring charges are added to your Shopify invoice every 30 days, or once a year on yearly billing.
Yes. Every plan includes a 21-day free trial, and you are not charged if you uninstall before it ends.

faqs.q: Can I save with yearly billing?
faqs.a: Yes. Advance, Professional and Unlimited can be billed yearly, which saves 20% compared with paying monthly. Starter is billed monthly.

faqs.q: Can I change or cancel my plan?
faqs.a: Yes. Change plans from the app at any time; Shopify asks you to approve the new charge. To cancel, uninstall InkyBay from your Shopify admin.
